name: EPIC 216866559

text.card: A red giant 5,332 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.02 solar masses and 21.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,278 K at its surface.
